title: The trace class is the diagonal supported pairing
statement:
Fix the coefficient conventions, $A=A_{E,n}$, $s=\Spec k$, let
$c=(c_1,c_2):C\to X\times_sX$ be an admissible correspondence
([def-trf-correspondence]) with fixed scheme $F=\Fix(c)$ and fixed-square
maps $i_F:F\to C$, $d:F\to X$ ([def-trf-fixed-scheme]), let
$K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ and $u:Lc_2^*K\to Rc_1^!K$. Assume the exceptional
admissibility ([def-trf-admissibility]) required by
[def-trf-supported-pairing] for the diagonal opposite pair
$(C,c,u)$, $(X,\Delta_X,1_K)$ and by
[lem-trf-trace-map-from-external-duality]. Then the Borel–Moore section
of the diagonal pair ([def-trf-supported-pairing]) is the Verdier trace
class of [def-trf-trace-class]:

$$
\langle u,1_K\rangle_{\mathrm{LV}}=\Tr_c(u)
\qquad\text{in }\Hom_{D(F,A)}(A_F,\omega_{F,A}).
$$

The equality holds exactly, with no sign and no twist: both sides are
the exceptional adjoint, along $d$, of the class of $u$ read through the
Künneth–Verdier isomorphism, base changed to the diagonal and evaluated.

proof.text: *Notation and supported classes.* Put $Z=X\times_sX$, with projections $p_1,p_2$, diagonal $\Delta$, exchange $\tau$, and $e=c i_F=\Delta d$. Put $D=D_XK$, $\omega=\omega_{X,A}$ and $P=K\boxtimes D$. Write $e':L\Delta^*P\cong K\otimes D\xrightarrow{\mathrm{sym}}D\otimes K\xrightarrow{\mathrm{ev}_K}\omega$, and let $e_K:P\to R\Delta_*\omega$ be its ordinary adjoint, exactly as specified in [lem-trf-trace-map-from-external-duality]. Write $\operatorname{adj}_f$ for the specified exceptional Hom bijection of [def-trf-admissibility]. By the diagonal clause of [def-trf-supported-pairing], its support intersection is $F$, its maps are $i_F,d,e$, and its first supported class is $\widetilde u=\kappa^{-1}[u]:Rc_!A_C\to P$, with $\kappa=\kappa_{K,K}$ of [thm-trf-kunneth-verdier] and $[u]$ of [lem-trf-correspondence-class]. Write $\widetilde u_{\mathrm{tr}}:A_C\to\mathcal H_c(K)$ for the mate of [def-trf-trace-class-source]. All symmetries retain their Koszul signs.

source.place: Notation: objects, evaluation and supported classes

proof.text: *Dualizing targets.* Write $\rho_f:Rf^!\omega_Y\cong\omega_T$ for [thm-trf-dualizing-complex-composition], for $f:T\to Y$. Apply it to $\Delta,d,e$. The comparison $Re^!\cong Rd^!R\Delta^!$ is the conjugate of compact-support composition, by [def-trf-admissibility]. The composite Hom bijection is the two successive Hom bijections of [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]. Consequently the functoriality in $f$ of the dualizing comparison gives $\rho_e=\rho_d\circ Rd^!(\rho_\Delta)$ under that identification. In particular the $e$-adjoint with final target $\omega_F$ and successive $\Delta,d$-adjoints have the same target identification. This is the functorial dualizing comparison, rather than an independently chosen isomorphism.

source.place: Notation: functorial dualizing comparison and composite adjunction

proof.text:
*Step 1 (both constructions start from $\widetilde u$).* Let
$\xi:\mathcal H_c(K)\xrightarrow{\sim}Rc^!P$ be the comparison of
[thm-trf-verdier-duality]: the exchange
$\mathcal H_c(K)=\RHom_A(Lc^*Lp_2^*K,Rc^!Rp_1^!K)\cong
Rc^!\RHom_A(Lp_2^*K,Rp_1^!K)$ of
[lem-trf-exceptional-internal-hom-exchange], followed by
$Rc^!\kappa^{-1}$. We claim

$$
\xi\circ\widetilde u_{\mathrm{tr}}=\operatorname{adj}_c(\widetilde u).
\tag{1}
$$

Compute the canonical exchange by tensor–Hom and exceptional adjunction: evaluated on the test object $A_C$, the Hom chain reads
$\Hom_C(A_C,\mathcal H_c(K))\cong\Hom_C(Lc^*M,Rc^!N)\cong
\Hom_Z(Rc_!A_C\otimes M,N)\cong\Hom_Z(Rc_!A_C,\RHom_A(M,N))\cong
\Hom_C(A_C,Rc^!\RHom_A(M,N))$ with $M=Lp_2^*K$, $N=Rp_1^!K$, using
$A_C\otimes Lc^*M=Lc^*M$. Its first arrow is the mate bijection of
[def-trf-trace-class-source], and its middle arrows are, in reverse,
exactly the tensor–Hom, projection-formula and exceptional-adjunction
steps whose composite defines $[u]$ in [lem-trf-correspondence-class]
(with the same identifications $Lc_2^*=Lc^*Lp_2^*$,
$Rc_1^!=Rc^!Rp_1^!$). Hence the exchange sends $\widetilde u_{\mathrm{tr}}$
to $\operatorname{adj}_c([u])$, and by naturality of $\operatorname{adj}_c$
in its target, $Rc^!\kappa^{-1}\circ\operatorname{adj}_c([u])
=\operatorname{adj}_c(\kappa^{-1}[u])$, which is (1).

source.place: Step 1: both constructions start from the supported class

proof.text: *The trace class: objectwise formula.* Let $bc:L\Delta^*Rc_!\cong Rd_!Li_F^*$ and $BC:Rc^!R\Delta_*\cong Ri_{F*}Rd^!$ be the specified exchanges of [thm-trf-fixed-point-base-change](2). Put $h=e'\circ L\Delta^*\widetilde u\circ bc^{-1}:Rd_!A_F\to\omega$. The existing statement [lem-trf-trace-map-from-external-duality] identifies the trace morphism with global sections of $\varphi=(Ri_{F*}\rho_d)\circ BC\circ Rc^!e_K\circ\xi$. Therefore [def-trf-trace-class], by naturality of its global-sections Hom bijections, identifies $\Tr_c(u)$ with the $i_F$-adjoint of $\varphi\widetilde u_{\mathrm{tr}}$. By (1) and naturality of the exceptional Hom bijection, $Rc^!e_K\circ\xi\circ\widetilde u_{\mathrm{tr}}=\operatorname{adj}_c(g)$ for $g=e_K\widetilde u$.

*The trace class: transposition in the fixed square.* The right-adjoint exchange $BC$ is the conjugate of $bc^{-1}$ under $L\Delta^*Rc_!\dashv Rc^!R\Delta_*$ and $Rd_!Li_F^*\dashv Ri_{F*}Rd^!$, by [def-trf-admissibility]. The conjugate formula of [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate], with the composite Hom bijections of [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction], sends $g:Rc_!M\to R\Delta_*N$ to $\operatorname{adj}_d(g^\flat bc_M^{-1}):Li_F^*M\to Rd^!N$, after the $i_F$-adjunction; here $g^\flat$ is its $\Delta$-transpose. Equivalently both routes first transpose $g$ to $L\Delta^*Rc_!M\to N$, precompose by $bc_M^{-1}$, then transpose along $d$; this is the Hom-bijection meaning of conjugation. For $g=e_K\widetilde u$, naturality of the ordinary adjunction gives $g^\flat=e' L\Delta^*\widetilde u$. The preceding step thus gives $\Tr_c(u)=\rho_d\circ\operatorname{adj}_d(h)$.

source.place: Step 2: conjugation and the fixed-square Hom computation

proof.text: *The diagonal class, (3a).* Put $\widetilde v'=\kappa^{-1}[1_K]:R\Delta_!A_X\to P$. By [def-trf-supported-pairing] the opposite supported class is $\widetilde v=s_P R\tau_*\widetilde v':R\Delta_!A_X\to Q=D\boxtimes K$. Let $\gamma:P\otimes Q\to\omega_Z$ be its specified contraction. By [lem-trf-correspondence-class] for $c=\Delta$ and both legs identity, the tensor–Hom transpose $[1_K]^T:R\Delta_!K\to Rp_1^!K$ is the $\Delta$-adjoint of $K\cong R\Delta^!Rp_1^!K$. Indeed the defining bijection for $[1_K]$ transposes first by tensor–Hom, then by projection formula, then by exceptional adjunction, and returns $1_K$. Thus $[1_K]^T$ is the section map $l$ in [lem-trf-section-evaluation-adjoint] for $(f,j)=(p_1,\Delta)$.

source.place: Step 3(a): supported diagonal identity and its transpose

proof.text:
*(3b), the transpose of kappa.* The map $\kappa$ is the map specified in [def-sf-kv-maps](iii),(iv), identified as an isomorphism by [thm-trf-kunneth-verdier]. Its tensor–Hom transpose is $\kappa^T=\alpha_{\operatorname{id},a_X}\circ(1\otimes Lp_2^*\operatorname{ev}_K):P\otimes Lp_2^*K\to Rp_1^!K$: in (iii) the first Hom is $R\mathcal Hom(A_X,K)=K$, so its evaluation is the unit identification. Transposing $\kappa\widetilde v'=[1_K]$ therefore gives
$$\kappa^T\circ(\widetilde v'\otimes1)=[1_K]^T.\tag{3}$$
This uses naturality of the tensor–Hom bijection and retains the same signed reassociations as that definition.

*(3c), extracted contraction comparison.* Apply [lem-trf-verdier-contraction-factorization] to this $X,K$. With its $\varpi$, signed permutation $r$ and $\gamma^\tau=L\tau^*\gamma\circ(1\otimes L\tau^*s_P)$, it gives $\gamma^\tau=\varpi(1\otimes\kappa^T)r$. Naturality of $r$ and (3) imply
$$\gamma^\tau(1\otimes\widetilde v')=\varpi(1\otimes[1_K]^T)r',$$
where $r':L\tau^*P\otimes R\Delta_!A_X\cong Lp_1^*D\otimes(R\Delta_!A_X\otimes Lp_2^*K)$ is the same signed permutation with the supported-class input. No additional exceptional-product coherence is assumed in this step: that comparison is precisely the statement of the cited new node.

source.place: Step 3(c): cite the extracted signed contraction factorization

proof.text:
*(3d), extracted section evaluation.* Apply [lem-trf-section-evaluation-adjoint] with $(f,j)=(p_1,\Delta)$, $W=\omega$ and $v=\operatorname{ev}_K$. Its section map is $[1_K]^T$ by (3a); its $V$ is exactly $\varpi$. Hence the $\Delta$-adjoint of $\varpi(1\otimes[1_K]^T)$, through the displayed projection formula, is $\operatorname{ev}_K$. In $r'$ the restriction of the remaining factors is $K\otimes D\to D\otimes K$, the signed symmetry, by [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso]. Since $\tau\Delta=\Delta$, the same pullback-composition comparisons identify the $\Delta$-adjoint before and after the factor exchange. Thus the $\Delta$-adjoint of $\gamma(1_P\otimes\widetilde v)\pi_P^{-1}$ is $e'$. The exceptional Hom bijection of [def-trf-admissibility] now gives
$$\gamma(1_P\otimes\widetilde v)=\varepsilon_\Delta R\Delta_!(e')\pi_P,\tag{2}$$
where $\pi_P:P\otimes R\Delta_!A_X\cong R\Delta_!L\Delta^*P$.

source.place: Step 3(d): cite section evaluation, and retain the signed symmetry

proof.text:
*The support product.* Let $\mu:Re_!A_F\cong Rc_!A_C\otimes R\Delta_!A_X$ be the map of [def-trf-supported-pairing], Step 2. The extracted comparison [lem-trf-support-product-base-change] applies with $B=Z$, $U=C$, $V=X$, $f=c$, $g=\Delta$, $T=F$, $p=i_F$, $q=d$, $t=e$; its $\mu$ is by its statement this same map (composition, constant pullback, inverse base change $Lc^*R\Delta_!\cong Ri_{F!}Ld^*$, unit insertion, inverse projection formula for $c$), and its $bc$ is the exchange $bc$ of [thm-trf-fixed-point-base-change](2) used to define $h$ above, at $M=A_C$. It yields
$$\pi_{Rc_!A_C}\mu=R\Delta_!(bc^{-1})\circ(Re_!A_F\cong R\Delta_!Rd_!A_F).$$
Using (2), bifunctoriality of tensor and naturality of the projection formula of [prop-functor-package](5) in its second input, the pairing composite therefore becomes
$$\sigma_{u,1_K}=\gamma(\widetilde u\otimes\widetilde v)\mu=\varepsilon_\Delta R\Delta_!(h)\circ(Re_!A_F\cong R\Delta_!Rd_!A_F).$$

source.place: Step 4: cite extracted support-product comparison and substitute (2)

proof.text: *The supported pairing and the trace coincide.* The composite-adjunction Hom bijection of [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction] and the triangle identities of [def-trf-admissibility] send $\varepsilon_\Delta R\Delta_!(h)$ first to $h$, then to $\operatorname{adj}_d(h)$. Thus $\operatorname{adj}_e(\sigma_{u,1_K})=\operatorname{adj}_d(h)$ under $Re^!\omega_Z\cong Rd^!\omega$. By [def-trf-supported-pairing] and the dualizing-target compatibility in the second proof entry, this gives $\langle u,1_K\rangle_{\mathrm{LV}}=\rho_d\operatorname{adj}_d(h)=\Tr_c(u)$, as computed in Step 2. Both computations end at $e'=\operatorname{ev}_K\circ\mathrm{sym}$, so the equality contains the same Koszul symmetry and no additional sign or twist.

source.place: Step 4: successive adjunctions and the final equality
